approved_command_preview: On PR #415 branch, stale-base check the parity reporter, replace the silent empty except with a stderr warning that preserves fallback behavior, run targeted Python validation, commit, and push the fix.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$branch = 'issue-414-agent-release-parity-report'
$path = 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/report_agent_release_parity.py'
$expectedBlob = '47dc80ccb0ed4006440b5f2cd05c7a118082f8da'
function Invoke-Logged([string[]]$GitArgs) {
  Write-Host "git $($GitArgs -join ' ')"
  $output = & git @GitArgs
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($output) { $output | Out-Host }
  if ($code -ne 0) { throw "git failed with exit $code`: git $($GitArgs -join ' ')" }
}
function Get-TrackedBlob([string]$Path) {
  $line = (& git ls-files -s -- $Path)
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { throw "Unable to read tracked blob for $Path" }
  return (($line -split '\s+')[1])
}
Invoke-Logged @('fetch', '--no-tags', 'origin', "refs/heads/$branch`:refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
Invoke-Logged @('checkout', '-B', $branch, "origin/$branch")
Invoke-Logged @('config', 'user.name', 'github-actions[bot]')
Invoke-Logged @('config', 'user.email', '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com')
$actualBlob = Get-TrackedBlob -Path $path
Write-Host "$path blob=$actualBlob"
if ($actualBlob -ne $expectedBlob) { throw "Blob mismatch for $path expected $expectedBlob got $actualBlob" }
$py = @'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/report_agent_release_parity.py')
data = path.read_bytes()
old_lf = b"""        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError):
            pass
"""
new_lf = b"""        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError) as exc:
            print(
                'warning: unable to read pull_request head sha from '
                f'GITHUB_EVENT_PATH ({event_path}): {exc}',
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
"""
old_crlf = old_lf.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n')
new_crlf = new_lf.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n')
matches = [(old_lf, new_lf), (old_crlf, new_crlf)]
matches = [(old, new) for old, new in matches if data.count(old) == 1]
if len(matches) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one empty-except block, found {len(matches)} matching newline styles')
old, new = matches[0]
path.write_bytes(data.replace(old, new, 1))
'@
$tempScript = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'fix-pr415-codeql-empty-except.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($tempScript, $py, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
python $tempScript
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CodeQL fix script failed' }
Invoke-Logged @('diff', '--check', '--', $path)
python -m py_compile $path
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'py_compile failed' }
python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/report_agent_release_parity_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'release parity selftest failed' }
python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'USB package integration selftest failed' }
Invoke-Logged @('add', '--', $path)
Invoke-Logged @('commit', '-m', 'Address CodeQL empty except in parity reporter')
Invoke-Logged @('push', 'origin', "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch")
Write-Host 'Final branch head:'
Invoke-Logged @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
